summary: Require milestones on Release issues and add a warning-first PR milestone check for Feature/Bug/Documentation pull requests.
migration_impact: Release issues now fail CI when no milestone is assigned. Feature, Bug, and issue-driven Documentation PRs now emit a visible warning when the PR milestone is missing, but do not fail yet.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure Release issues are created with a GitHub milestone.
2. Start assigning the owning Epic or release milestone to Feature, Bug, and issue-driven Documentation PRs.
3. Treat the PR milestone warning as a migration aid; future PLATE slices may tighten it from warning to failure.
agent_notes: Use the PR warning phase to clean up active milestone hygiene before converting the check into a hard fail in a later slice.
